items.t: Fought for every New Jerseyan to have the right to receive a driver's license and stands with immigrant communities and their right to pursue the American dream.
items.q: She fought to ensure every New Jerseyan has the right to receive a driver's license and she stands with our immigrant communities and their right to pursue the American dream.

record.t: Led the effort to expand paid family leave and punish wage theft.
record.q: As an Assemblywoman, Annette Quijano led the charge to expand paid family leave and punish wage theft.

record.t: Became the first woman and first Latina to serve as Assembly Speaker Pro Tempore.
record.q: She became the first woman and first Latina to serve as Assembly Speaker Pro Tempore.

record.t: Serves as Vice-Chair of the Assembly Consumer Affairs Committee and as a member of the Assembly Housing and Labor Committees.
record.q: She serves as Vice-Chair of the Assembly Consumer Affairs Committee and is a member of both the Assembly Housing Committee and the Assembly Labor Committee.

record.t: Chaired the Assembly Homeland Security and State Preparedness Committee and the Assembly Judiciary Committee.
record.q: She chaired the Assembly Homeland Security and State Preparedness Committee and the Assembly Judiciary Committee.
